title: Signature 18 · Muscle Hourglass · Dancheong · Palace Eaves
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her mid 30s, sleek center-parted low bun with a gold binyeo.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Korean dancheong body painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Glossy celadon green, vermilion, cobalt blue, and golden yellow in the style of palace eave painting, large layered lotus medallions and continuous cloud scrolls. The lotus medallions wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing facing the camera in a relaxed contrapposto, her weight on one leg so that hip juts outward, the other heel lifted, arms relaxed away from the body, no flexing.

Footwear: Extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, vermilion with celadon tips.

Background & Lighting: Beneath the eaves of a Korean royal palace hall, painted dancheong rafters and red columns softly out of focus, warm daylight glowing beyond, the background much lighter than her body, warm bounce light carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads, making the glossy colors gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
